text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after finishing shopping for 
training gear, I was passing through the 
shopping district when...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...Hmmmm~?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Trainer! Gimme a lottery ticket, 
pleeease!
choice_data_list: A raffle ticket? Did I have one?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
You got one from shopping earlier, didn't 
you! Come on, come on, hurry up~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hurried along, I checked, and sure enough, 
there was one mixed in among the receipts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"From the looks of it, it was probably 
handed over tucked inside the receipt. I 
don't recall any particular explanation 
either. No wonder I didn't notice it, I 
thought."
choice_data_list: You knew about that, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Nfuh. I'm the type of Umamusume with wide 
peripheral vision, after all~~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, why are you surprised by something 
like that? The real show starts now!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I'm super good at this kind of thing! 
Just watch me☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora enthusiastically turned 
the raffle wheel's handle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: See?♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha, told ya so♡ Total breeze. So here, 
this is for you♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
B-But I've already been there with Mom and 
Dad. It was super fun, sure, but going 
twice is kinda boring~~

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Tired from work, Trainer? Got stiff 
shoulders or somethin'? Well then, here 
you gooo!"
choice_data_list: If that's the case... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The hot springs there are super nice! 
There was like, fruit floating in it, 
which cracked me up ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The amusement park was great, and there 
was this amazing shrine, too? Oh, and 
maybe a regional racing museum as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to the story, I glanced at the 
ticket and saw that it could be used for 
pairs. Maybe one of my colleagues would be 
interested.
choice_data_list:
I see. I'll invite someone and go check it 
out.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehh, maybe I should just go after all.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I know they're pair tickets, but I totally 
thought you'd just go alone~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, aren't I the right one 
for the job? Like, totally. I am your 
assigned Umamusume, after all~
choice_data_list:
Still, she said she got bored of it after 
going just once...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If you've been there once, that means you 
know all about it, right? Which means you 
can guide us! That's perrr-fect!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So please set up a schedule for me. Thanks 
a bunch♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, I made a promise to go on a 
hot springs trip with Fusaichi Pandora 
whenever we found the time."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aha, I messed up~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Well, but isn't 1st prize super great 
too? Totally good enough! Nice fight, nice 
fight☆"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —So, what should we do about this?
choice_data_list: Wanna have this for dinner tonight?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Totes, I know! But come on, I was the one 
who pulled it, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like, don't you wanna eat it in a super 
special setting? Or rather, I want you to 
eat it~♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Fusaichi Pandora rushing me, the 
situation I came up with was—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah-ha☆ Dinner on a hilltop while gazing at 
the sunset?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, we're just eating outdoors, 
so it's not much of a special scenario or 
anything.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Sooooo coooool♡ An evening picnic is so 
emo! So chill~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The hamburg steak is yummy too! Like, the 
carrot looks ready to take flight, it's so 
funny ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, let's eat here again. Right, 
Trainer? ♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora was delighted. 
Afterwards, the two of us enjoyed the 
"ultra-special dinner" together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Whaaat~! 2nd Prize!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, so today's just not my day? 
Seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Well, but a whole mountain of carrots 
isn't bad either, right? Mom just taught 
me a carrot cake recipe the other day, so 
isn't this actually pretty lucky~?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Look at this towering mountain of cake I 
ma— ............

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That's it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Pandora-chan's homemade carrot pound 
cake!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Everyone's always giving me snacks, 
helping me with homework, and letting me 
borrow their erasers, right~?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So this is a thank-you to all my 
classmates, I love you all sho sho much♡

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if that's the case... Thank you, 
Pandora-chan!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It has such a gentle fragrance, 
like a fragrant breeze. Thank you very 
much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
There's a face drawn on the slice♡ So 
cute~. Can I post this on Umastagram?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing♡ Make sure to add the hashtag 
#GeniusPatissiere♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that everyone was pleased, Fusaichi 
Pandora looked utterly delighted.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Noooo!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aww, come on, why?! It was supposed to be 
the Grand Prize, not 3rd place~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Sigh. Well, whatever, I guess it can't be 
helped. This carrot must be happy it was 
won by me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So, what should we do with this! I mean, 
we could just eat it normally. We could, 
but still...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't you make it a bit tastier for 
me~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Nhehe♡ So sweeet!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
You're a total genius, Trainer~! It's 
pink, cute, and just the best~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
You've got way too much talent~. Once I 
retire, maybe I should open a chocolate 
carrot shop, huh? Setting up a festival 
stall and all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Fusaichi Pandora devoured the 
chocolate carrots in no time flat, and—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Welcome back♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Go buy it for me ♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, Fusaichi Pandora seemed 
quite pleased.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Gaaahhh~! Whyyyy~!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, losing sucks, no no no~! Hey, give 
me another raffle ticket, pleaaase!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Buy me cake then, pleaaase!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Geez, whyyy! *sniff*... Total bummer. 
*sob*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora looked utterly 
disappointed after losing the lottery.
